description: This file defines the PayloadMapping interface, which is used for referencing multiple payload mappings in the context of message processing within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes method signatures for retrieving payload mappings and checking if the mapping set is empty.

classes.name: PayloadMapping
classes.description: Interface for referencing multiple payload mappings within message payloads, supporting inbound and outbound message processing in the Eclipse Ditto model connectivity.

methods.name: getMappings
methods.description: Returns the list of payload mapping identifiers to be applied for messages.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the payload mapping list is empty, indicating no mappings are defined.
